answer_1.quote: Specifically, we focus on the task of chess commentary generation to explain given decisions.

answer_2.quote: Previous works rely on similarity-based metrics such as BLEU, ... We propose GCC-Eval ...

answer_3.quote: We propose GCC-Eval ... (i) Multidimensional evaluation by an LLM. ... We measure the commentary's informativeness (relevance, completeness) and linguistic quality (clarity, fluency).
methods: multidimensional evaluation by an LLM with expert model guidance

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation settings We conducted a manual human evaluation to assess the quality of the generated chess commentary. ... Participants were asked to rate the commentary across ... correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity, and fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated commentary on correctness (3-point scale), relevance, completeness, clarity, and fluency (5-point Likert scales), with additional categorization for incorrectness.
